title: Chiral Magnetic effect as the anomaly in the transverse axial vector Ward Identity
summary: Through analyzing the quark propagator under the magnetic field, we establish that the axial anomaly originates from an additional Dirac structure in quark propagator induced by the magnetic field. This Dirac structure also allows one to connect the axial anomaly with the topological properties of the system by checking the axial vector Ward identity. For the tree level propagator, we reproduce the result of the anomalous axial current as in the Dirac Hamiltonian approach and kinetic theory.
